package.name: ww1lod
package.notes: This dataset contains strictly quality-controlled rich information on events, actors and places related to the First World War. As such, it is meant to be used as a reference dataset to which other datasets (e.g. museum or library collections dealing with WW1 topics) can be linked.
package.title: World War 1 as Linked Open Data
